# Zostaje

> Zostaje is a student-built budgeting and savings application in development. The primary website language is Polish; an English interface is available using the language selector.

## Product facts
- The first MVP targets iOS. Public installers are not available yet.
- The personal app is intended to work locally, free of charge and without a mandatory account.
- Planning uses a dated current balance, the next income date, unpaid bills, a chosen buffer and a savings-goal reserve. Results are estimates based on those inputs, not financial guarantees or transfers.
- A complete transaction history is not required for the first plan. CSV import uses a documented format. Bank integrations are a future direction.
- AI is optional. The free edition allows users to connect their own AI. Paid services are in development.
- Premium is advertised at PLN 39/month or PLN 397.80/year (15% below twelve monthly payments), with managed AI and additional analytics.
- Founders Edition is a paid, tailored offering for freelancers, startups and sole traders: onboarding, additional analytical tools and optional self-hosting. Scope and budget are agreed individually. Contact: sales@zostaje.com.
- The thesis page describes project goals and hypotheses, not established research findings.
